rationale: Opportunity-engine role features (route share, targets per route run, snap share, red-zone and inside-5 shares, team point-in-time volume) improved calibrated P(Y >= k) on all six player statistics tested, walk-forward 2019-2025, with the sign consistent in 6-7 of 7 seasons per statistic. Every one of those seasons is retrospective. Frozen into shadow-0.3.0 (artifact 76facd384b51e817) before the first 2026 kickoff.
target: Brier and log loss of P(Y >= k) at listed Kalshi rungs, player statistic ladders
expected_direction: shadow-0.3.0 beats the shadow-0.2.0 feature set on 2026 rungs by roughly the retrospective margin: Brier -0.003 on targets and receptions, smaller on the yards ladders
test_plan: Prospective. Both feature sets are priced on every 2026 slate and written to the shadow ledger; score both against settled outcomes at season end. Pre-specified primary endpoint: pooled Brier across all settled PLAYER_STAT rungs. No subgroup will be promoted.
dataset: market-data shadow ledger 2026 + nflverse settled outcomes
result: IN DOUBT on the traded population. On the exact 2025 Kalshi rungs (12,553 settled contracts, tradable books) the role arm scores Brier 0.20151 against the base arm's 0.20034: +0.00117 +- 0.00104, directionally WORSE and not significant. Splitting the fixed-ladder 2025 evaluation by whether Kalshi listed the player-game shows why: the improvement is concentrated in players Kalshi does NOT list (receptions -0.00505 +- 0.00048, z=-10.4) and is ~0 on listed players (-0.00010 +- 0.00068). Kalshi lists established starters, whose raw EWMA already captures their role.
notes: A retrospective improvement of this size is small enough that one 2026 season will not settle it decisively; the registration exists so the comparison cannot be reframed after the fact. The retrospective 6/6 result stands on the population it was measured on, and does not transfer to the traded one. This also questions freezing shadow-0.3.0 rather than the 0.2.0 feature set; the difference cannot distinguish them, so the freeze stands rather than being re-cut on non-significant evidence.
